title: "6.Neuronal_Markers"
output: html_document
date: "2026-10-16"
---

```{r}
# iHD10.6 -> dHD10.6 NEURONAL DIFFERENTIATION MARKER HEATMAP

# Groups:
#   DRG / sensory neuron
#   Nociceptive
#   Peripheral neuron
#   Pan-neuronal
#   Cell cycle

# 1. SETTINGS
expression_file <-
  "data_or_results/R_Analysis_ORA/VZVvsMock.complete_1.xlsx"

expression_sheet <- "Ordered_by_FC"

output_dir <-
  "data_or_results/R_Analysis_ORA/7._DRG_neuronal_markers/Output/Neuron_marker_classes"
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 2. SAMPLES

samples <- data.frame(

  column = c(
    "norm.HD10.und_1",
    "norm.HD10.und_2",
    "norm.HD10.und_3",
    "norm.HD10.diff_1",
    "norm.HD10.diff_2",
    "norm.HD10.diff_3"
  ),

  label = c(
    "iHD10.6 1",
    "iHD10.6 2",
    "iHD10.6 3",
    "dHD10.6 1",
    "dHD10.6 2",
    "dHD10.6 3"
  ),

  group = c(
    rep("iHD10.6", 3),
    rep("dHD10.6", 3)
  ),

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 3. MARKER SETS = manually picked from CellMarker 3.0


marker_sets <- list(


  "DRG / sensory neuron" = c(

    "ISL1",
    "POU4F1",

    "NTRK1",
    "NTRK2",
    "NTRK3",

    "PRDM12",

    "RUNX1",
    "RUNX3",

    "NEUROD1",
    "NEUROD4",

    "TLX3",

    "ERBB3",
    "ERBB4",

    "SLC17A6",

    "KCNQ2",
    "KCNQ3",

    "PIEZO2"
  ),


  "Nociceptive" = c(

    "TRPV1",
    "TRPA1",

    "SCN9A",
    "SCN10A",
    "SCN11A",

    "P2RX3",

    "TAC1",
    "CALCA",
    "CALCB",

    "NTS",
    "SST",
    "GAL",
    "PENK",
    "NPY",

    "GFRA1",
    "GFRA2",
    "GFRA3",

    "RET",

    "ASIC3",

    "TRPM8",

    "HTR3A",

    "CHRNA3",

    "MRGPRD",
    "MRGPRX1"
  ),


  "Peripheral neuron" = c(

    "PRPH",

    "PLP1",

    "GAP43",

    "UCHL1",

    "INA",

    "NEFH",
    "NEFM",
    "NEFL",

    "STMN2",

    "DPYSL3",

    "NCAM1",

    "CNTN1",
    "CNTN2",

    "L1CAM",

    "SEMA3A",

    "NRP1",
    "NRP2"
  ),


  "Pan-neuronal" = c(

    "TUBB3",

    "RBFOX3",

    "MAP2",
    "MAPT",

    "SNAP25",

    "SYN1",
    "SYN2",

    "SYT1",

    "SYP",

    "DLG4",

    "NEFL",
    "NEFM",
    "NEFH",

    "ELAVL3",
    "ELAVL4",

    "ENO2",

    "STMN2",

    "GAP43",

    "NCAM1",

    "VAMP2",

    "STX1A",
    "STX1B"
  ),


  "Cell cycle" = c(

    "MKI67",

    "PCNA",

    "MCM2",
    "MCM3",
    "MCM4",
    "MCM5",
    "MCM6",
    "MCM7",

    "CCNA2",

    "CCNB1",
    "CCNB2",

    "CCNE1",
    "CCNE2",

    "CDK1",
    "CDK2",

    "CDC20",
    "CDC25A",
    "CDC25B",
    "CDC25C",

    "CDCA2",
    "CDCA3",
    "CDCA5",
    "CDCA7",
    "CDCA8",

    "TOP2A",

    "BIRC5",

    "AURKA",
    "AURKB",

    "PLK1",

    "BUB1",
    "BUB1B",

    "MAD2L1",

    "NDC80",

    "CENPA",
    "CENPE",
    "CENPF",

    "KIF11",
    "KIF20A",
    "KIF23",

    "TPX2",

    "UBE2C",

    "RRM2",

    "TYMS"
  )
)

# 4. CATEGORY ORDER

category_order <- c(

  "DRG / sensory neuron",

  "Nociceptive",

  "Peripheral neuron",

  "Pan-neuronal",

  "Cell cycle"

)

# 6. FIGURE SETTINGS

cell_width  <- 18
cell_height <- 13

fontsize_gene   <- 9
fontsize_sample <- 9
fontsize_group  <- 9
fontsize_legend <- 8

figure_width  <- 8
figure_height <- NULL

png_dpi <- 600

cluster_distance <- "euclidean"
cluster_method   <- "complete"

z_limit <- 2.5

# LEFT GROUP ANNOTATION
# Width reserved for text + vertical group lines
group_annotation_width <- 1.55   # inches

# Distance between group text and vertical line
group_text_offset <- 0.10

# Thickness of vertical line
group_line_width <- 1.0

# Color
group_line_color <- "black"

# Category labels
group_labels <- c(

  "DRG / sensory neuron" = "DRG / sensory",

  "Nociceptive" = "Nociceptive",

  "Peripheral neuron" = "Peripheral neuron",

  "Pan-neuronal" = "Pan-neuronal",

  "Cell cycle" = "Cell cycle"

)

# 7. PACKAGES

cran_packages <- c(
  "readxl",
  "pheatmap",
  "RColorBrewer",
  "gtable"
)

bioc_packages <- c(
  "AnnotationDbi",
  "org.Hs.eg.db"
)


for (pkg in cran_packages) {

  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {

    install.packages(
      pkg,
      repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
    )

  }

}


if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {

  install.packages(
    "BiocManager",
    repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
  )

}


for (pkg in bioc_packages) {

  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {

    BiocManager::install(
      pkg,
      ask = FALSE,
      update = FALSE
    )

  }

}

# 8. OUTPUT DIRECTORY
dir.create(
  output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


# 9. READ EXPRESSION DATA

message("Reading expression workbook...")


expr <- as.data.frame(

  readxl::read_excel(

    expression_file,

    sheet = expression_sheet,

    .name_repair = "minimal"

  )

)


if (!all(c("gene_id", "gene_name") %in% names(expr))) {

  stop(
    "Expression workbook must contain gene_id and gene_name."
  )

}


missing_sample_columns <-
  setdiff(
    samples$column,
    names(expr)
  )


if (length(missing_sample_columns)) {

  stop(

    "Missing sample columns: ",

    paste(
      missing_sample_columns,
      collapse = ", "
    )

  )

}


expr$gene_id <-
  sub(
    "\\.[0-9]+$",
    "",
    as.character(expr$gene_id)
  )


expr <-
  expr[
    grepl(
      "^ENSG[0-9]+$",
      expr$gene_id
    ),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


# 10. MAP ENSEMBL -> SYMBOL
message("Mapping Ensembl identifiers...")


human_db <-
  org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db


valid_ids <-
  intersect(

    unique(expr$gene_id),

    AnnotationDbi::keys(
      human_db,
      keytype = "ENSEMBL"
    )

  )


mapping <-
  AnnotationDbi::select(

    human_db,

    keys = valid_ids,

    keytype = "ENSEMBL",

    columns = "SYMBOL"

  )


mapping <-
  mapping[
    !is.na(mapping$SYMBOL),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


mapping <- unique(mapping)


symbol_by_id <-
  split(
    mapping$SYMBOL,
    mapping$ENSEMBL
  )


expr$SYMBOL <-
  vapply(

    expr$gene_id,

    function(id) {

      x <- unique(
        symbol_by_id[[id]]
      )

      x <- x[
        !is.na(x)
      ]


      if (length(x)) {

        return(
          x[1]
        )

      }


      j <- match(
        id,
        expr$gene_id
      )


      fallback <-
        as.character(
          expr$gene_name[j]
        )


      if (
        !is.na(fallback) &&
        nzchar(fallback)
      ) {

        return(fallback)

      }


      NA_character_

    },

    FUN.VALUE = character(1)

  )


expr$SYMBOL <-
  toupper(expr$SYMBOL)

# 11. CLEAN MARKER SETS
marker_sets <-
  marker_sets[
    category_order
  ]


marker_sets <-
  lapply(
    marker_sets,
    toupper
  )


# Remove accidental duplicates within each marker set
marker_sets <-
  lapply(
    marker_sets,
    unique
  )

# 12. REMOVE DUPLICATES BETWEEN CATEGORIES
# First category containing a gene gets priority.

already_used <- character(0)


for (category in category_order) {


  genes <-
    marker_sets[[category]]


  genes <-
    setdiff(
      genes,
      already_used
    )


  marker_sets[[category]] <-
    genes


  already_used <-
    union(
      already_used,
      genes
    )

}

# 13. BUILD MARKER TABLE
marker_table <-
  do.call(

    rbind,

    lapply(

      category_order,

      function(category) {

        data.frame(

          marker =
            marker_sets[[category]],

          category =
            category,

          stringsAsFactors = FALSE

        )

      }

    )

  )


rownames(marker_table) <- NULL


utils::write.csv(

  marker_table,

  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "requested_marker_panel.csv"
  ),

  row.names = FALSE

)

# 14. FIND AVAILABLE MARKERS

marker_table$available <-
  marker_table$marker %in%
  expr$SYMBOL


available_markers <-
  marker_table[
    marker_table$available,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


missing_markers <-
  marker_table[
    !marker_table$available,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


utils::write.csv(

  missing_markers,

  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "markers_not_found_in_expression_matrix.csv"
  ),

  row.names = FALSE

)


message(
  "Requested markers: ",
  nrow(marker_table)
)

message(
  "Available markers: ",
  nrow(available_markers)
)

message(
  "Missing markers: ",
  nrow(missing_markers)
)

# 15. HANDLE DUPLICATE EXPRESSION SYMBOLS

sample_matrix_all <-
  as.matrix(
    expr[
      ,
      samples$column,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  )


storage.mode(sample_matrix_all) <-
  "numeric"


expr$mean_selected_expression <-
  rowMeans(
    sample_matrix_all,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )


expr <-
  expr[

    order(
      expr$SYMBOL,
      -expr$mean_selected_expression
    ),

    ,

    drop = FALSE

  ]


expr <-
  expr[
    !duplicated(expr$SYMBOL),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

# 16. BUILD EXPRESSION MATRIX
available_markers <-
  available_markers[
    available_markers$marker %in%
      expr$SYMBOL,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


idx <-
  match(
    available_markers$marker,
    expr$SYMBOL
  )


selected_expr <-
  expr[
    idx,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


mat <-
  as.matrix(

    selected_expr[
      ,
      samples$column,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

  )


storage.mode(mat) <-
  "numeric"


rownames(mat) <-
  available_markers$marker


colnames(mat) <-
  samples$label

# 17. REMOVE NON-FINITE ROWS
finite_rows <-
  apply(

    mat,

    1,

    function(x)
      all(is.finite(x))

  )


mat <-
  mat[
    finite_rows,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


available_markers <-
  available_markers[
    finite_rows,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

# 18. PER-GENE Z SCORE
zmat <-
  t(
    scale(
      t(mat)
    )
  )


zmat[
  !is.finite(zmat)
] <- 0


# Clip extreme values

zmat[
  zmat > z_limit
] <- z_limit


zmat[
  zmat < -z_limit
] <- -z_limit

# 19. CLUSTER WITHIN EACH CATEGORY
ordered_genes <- character(0)

category_sizes <- integer(0)


for (category in category_order) {


  genes <-
    available_markers$marker[
      available_markers$category ==
        category
    ]


  genes <-
    intersect(
      genes,
      rownames(zmat)
    )


  if (!length(genes)) {

    next

  }


  if (length(genes) >= 2) {


    category_matrix <-
      zmat[
        genes,
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ]


    d <-
      stats::dist(

        category_matrix,

        method =
          cluster_distance

      )


    hc <-
      stats::hclust(

        d,

        method =
          cluster_method

      )


    genes <-
      genes[
        hc$order
      ]

  }


  ordered_genes <-
    c(
      ordered_genes,
      genes
    )


  category_sizes[category] <-
    length(genes)

}


zmat <-
  zmat[
    ordered_genes,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


mat <-
  mat[
    ordered_genes,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

# 20. COLUMN ANNOTATION

annotation_col <-
  data.frame(

    Condition =
      factor(

        samples$group,

        levels = c(
          "iHD10.6",
          "dHD10.6"
        )

      ),

    row.names =
      samples$label

  )


annotation_colors <-
  list(

    Condition = c(

      "iHD10.6" =
        "#E69F00",

      "dHD10.6" =
        "#009E73"

    )

  )

# 21. CATEGORY GAPS

category_sizes <-
  category_sizes[
    category_sizes > 0
  ]


if (length(category_sizes) > 1) {

  gaps_row <-
    cumsum(category_sizes)[
      -length(category_sizes)
    ]

} else {

  gaps_row <- NULL

}

# 22. HEATMAP COLOR SCALE
heat_colors <-
  grDevices::colorRampPalette(

    rev(

      RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(
        11,
        "RdBu"
      )

    )

  )(100)


breaks <-
  seq(
    -z_limit,
    z_limit,
    length.out = 101
  )

# 23. FIGURE HEIGHT
if (is.null(figure_height)) {

  figure_height <-
    max(

      6,

      nrow(zmat) *
        cell_height / 72 +
        2.4

    )

}

# 24. CREATE HEATMAP
# NOTE:
# No annotation_row is used anymore.
# manually draw the group annotation next to the gene names.

hm <-
  pheatmap::pheatmap(

    zmat,

    scale = "none",

    color = heat_colors,

    breaks = breaks,

    annotation_col =
      annotation_col,

    annotation_colors =
      annotation_colors,

    cluster_rows = FALSE,

    cluster_cols = FALSE,

    gaps_row = gaps_row,

    gaps_col = 3,

    treeheight_row = 0,

    treeheight_col = 0,

    cellwidth =
      cell_width,

    cellheight =
      cell_height,

    show_rownames = TRUE,

    show_colnames = TRUE,

    fontsize_row =
      fontsize_gene,

    fontsize_col =
      fontsize_sample,

    fontsize =
      fontsize_legend,

    angle_col = "45",

    border_color = NA,

    main = NA,

    legend = TRUE,

    annotation_legend = TRUE,

    silent = TRUE

  )


# 25. ADD CUSTOM LEFT-SIDE GROUP ANNOTATION
gt <- hm$gtable


# Find the actual heatmap matrix location
matrix_index <-
  which(
    gt$layout$name == "matrix"
  )


if (length(matrix_index) != 1) {

  stop(
    "Could not uniquely identify the heatmap matrix in the pheatmap gtable."
  )

}


matrix_row <-
  gt$layout$t[
    matrix_index
  ]


matrix_col <-
  gt$layout$l[
    matrix_index
  ]

# Insert new column immediately LEFT of the heatmap

gt <-
  gtable::gtable_add_cols(

    gt,

    widths =
      grid::unit(
        group_annotation_width,
        "in"
      ),

    pos =
      matrix_col - 1

  )


# After inserting a column, locate the matrix again.

matrix_index <-
  which(
    gt$layout$name == "matrix"
  )


matrix_row <-
  gt$layout$t[
    matrix_index
  ]


matrix_col <-
  gt$layout$l[
    matrix_index
  ]


# 26. BUILD CUSTOM GROUP GROBS
total_genes <-
  nrow(zmat)
# Cumulative starting/ending positions

group_end <-
  cumsum(
    category_sizes
  )


group_start <-
  c(
    1,
    head(group_end, -1) + 1
  )
# Convert row positions to NPC coordinates.
#
# pheatmap row 1 is at the TOP, whereas NPC y=0 is at the bottom.

row_height_npc <-
  1 / total_genes


annotation_grob <-
  grid::gTree()


for (i in seq_along(category_sizes)) {


  category <-
    names(category_sizes)[i]


  start_row <-
    group_start[i]


  end_row <-
    group_end[i]

  # Calculate category vertical extent
  y_top <-
    1 -
    (start_row - 1) /
    total_genes


  y_bottom <-
    1 -
    end_row /
    total_genes


  y_middle <-
    (
      y_top +
      y_bottom
    ) / 2

  # Vertical line
  line <-
    grid::segmentsGrob(

      x0 =
        grid::unit(
          0.96,
          "npc"
        ),

      x1 =
        grid::unit(
          0.96,
          "npc"
        ),

      y0 =
        grid::unit(
          y_bottom,
          "npc"
        ),

      y1 =
        grid::unit(
          y_top,
          "npc"
        ),

      gp =
        grid::gpar(

          col =
            group_line_color,

          lwd =
            group_line_width,

          lineend =
            "butt"

        )

    )

  # Category text
 
  label <-
    group_labels[
      category
    ]


  if (
    is.na(label) ||
    !nzchar(label)
  ) {

    label <- category

  }


  text_grob <-
    grid::textGrob(

      label = label,

      x =
        grid::unit(
          0.88,
          "npc"
        ),

      y =
        grid::unit(
          y_middle,
          "npc"
        ),

      just =
        c(
          "right",
          "centre"
        ),

      gp =
        grid::gpar(

          fontsize =
            fontsize_group,

          col =
            "black",

          fontface =
            "plain"

        )

    )


  annotation_grob <-
    grid::gTree(

      children =
        grid::gList(

          annotation_grob,

          line,

          text_grob

        )

    )

}

# 27. ADD ANNOTATION GROBS TO GTABLE
gt <-
  gtable::gtable_add_grob(

    gt,

    grobs =
      annotation_grob,

    t =
      matrix_row,

    b =
      matrix_row,

    l =
      matrix_col - 1,

    r =
      matrix_col - 1,

    name =
      "marker_group_annotation",

    clip =
      "off"

  )

# 28. OUTPUT FILES

pdf_file <-
  file.path(

    output_dir,

    "HD10.6_neuronal_marker_heatmap_group_lines.pdf"

  )


png_file <-
  file.path(

    output_dir,

    "HD10.6_neuronal_marker_heatmap_group_lines.png"

  )


# 29. SAVE PDF
grDevices::pdf(

  pdf_file,

  width =
    figure_width,

  height =
    figure_height,

  useDingbats =
    FALSE

)


grid::grid.newpage()

grid::grid.draw(
  gt
)


grDevices::dev.off()

# 30. SAVE 600-DPI PNG
grDevices::png(

  png_file,

  width =
    figure_width,

  height =
    figure_height,

  units =
    "in",

  res =
    png_dpi

)


grid::grid.newpage()

grid::grid.draw(
  gt
)


grDevices::dev.off()

# 31. DISPLAY IN RSTUDIO
if (interactive()) {

  grid::grid.newpage()

  grid::grid.draw(
    gt
  )

}

# 32. EXPORT FINAL GENE ORDER
gene_to_category <-
  setNames(

    available_markers$category,

    available_markers$marker

  )


final_gene_table <-
  data.frame(

    order =
      seq_len(
        nrow(zmat)
      ),

    gene =
      rownames(zmat),

    category =
      gene_to_category[
        rownames(zmat)
      ],

    stringsAsFactors =
      FALSE

  )


utils::write.csv(

  final_gene_table,

  file.path(

    output_dir,

    "heatmap_final_gene_order.csv"

  ),

  row.names =
    FALSE

)

# 33. EXPORT Z-SCORE MATRIX
z_export <-
  data.frame(

    gene =
      rownames(zmat),

    category =
      gene_to_category[
        rownames(zmat)
      ],

    zmat,

    check.names =
      FALSE

  )


utils::write.csv(

  z_export,

  file.path(

    output_dir,

    "heatmap_row_Z_scores.csv"

  ),

  row.names =
    FALSE

)

# 34. SUMMARY
category_summary <-
  data.frame(

    category =
      names(category_sizes),

    genes_plotted =
      as.integer(
        category_sizes
      ),

    stringsAsFactors =
      FALSE

  )


utils::write.csv(

  category_summary,

  file.path(

    output_dir,

    "heatmap_category_summary.csv"

  ),

  row.names =
    FALSE

)


message("")
message("============================================================")
message("DONE")
message("============================================================")
message("")
message("PDF: ", pdf_file)
message("PNG: ", png_file)
message("")
message("Genes plotted: ", nrow(zmat))
message("")
print(category_summary)

```
